title: CreateEconomicEventInput
description: Input for creating REA economic events. Must match Rust CreateEconomicEventInputView in views.rs. Economic events are Category A (DHT-notarized) — they are the protocol's value accounting layer.

action.description: REA economic action (use, consume, produce, transfer, cite)

receiver.description: Agent or content receiving the resource

resourceConformsTo.description: ResourceSpecification URI the affected resource conforms to

resourceQuantityUnit.description: Unit of measure for resource quantity

inputOf.description: Process this event is an input to

outputOf.description: Process this event is an output of

contributorPresenceId.description: Contributor presence this event relates to

pathId.description: Learning path this event relates to

triggeredBy.description: ID of the signal or event that triggered this

atLocation.description: Place ID for spatial grounding of this event
